chunks: As for the report that was narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام, that he said:
If the beasts knew of death what you know, you would never eat anything fat from them.

key_terms.الْخَبَرُ: the report or narration being cited
key_terms.الْمَوْتِ: death, as a reality that should be remembered

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe the effect of remembering death?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام draws attention to the gravity of death through a vivid comparison with animals. It serves as an ethical reminder that awareness of death restrains indulgence and awakens reflection.
